BSO page on the Commission's energy website

description: The EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) is the European Commission's web tool for monitoring the energy performance of buildings across Europe, with the aim of providing transparent and reliable data on the EU building stock to monitor energy policies and inform future ones. It covers building stock, energy consumption, building elements and technical building systems, energy performance certificates, nearly zero-energy buildings and renovation rates, as well as energy poverty and financing. Factsheets give snapshots of indicators for the EU and each country, the database can be viewed by topic, year and country with sources cited, and the full dataset can be downloaded as an Excel file; the BSO was updated with new data in June 2026, and user testimonials, a manual and a video tutorial explain its use. Coverage: EU member states and the EU as a whole. Access: free web tool and download. Licence: Commission legal notice. Caveats: indicators come from many national sources, cited per table, so years and methods differ. Simulation uses are national building stock, energy and renovation baselines for stock models and decarbonisation scenarios. Related records: the Hotmaps building stock data.
